title: How First-Party Data Helps Marketers Win in 2026 (Guide)
excerpt: Brands using all their first-party data saw up to 2x incremental revenue. Here's how to collect it and use it in Meta, Google Ads and email.
metadesc: First-party data can drive up to 2x incremental revenue. Learn what it is, why it still matters despite Chrome cookies, and 6 steps to use it.
